responsibility: Implements the registry and matcher for analyzer known_function models, including plugin-supplied ones. It stores handlers by identifier, builtin code, or internal_fn slot, owns their lifetimes, and selects an applicable handler for a call by checking builtin identity or root-namespace function name together with call-type compatibility and known_function preconditions.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of known_function_manager declared in known-function-manager.h, including ownership cleanup, registration storage, and call-site matching across builtins, internal_fns, and root-namespace named functions.
